subject: Shortened interview window request — childcare overlap (Candidate: Elena Martinez)
messages:
From: Bryce Collins <bryce@talenthunt.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Elena Martinez — daycare cancellation, asking for compressed slot today

Hi Rafael / Marissa —

Quick heads up: Elena Martinez (SWE II) just had her daycare cancel this morning; she still wants to interview today but will need a shorter, consolidated block. Her original schedule was three back-to-back 45m interviews starting at 1pm PT. Shes asking whether we can compress to a single ~75 minute block or split into a short live screen + take-home coding task as a fallback.

Elena is comfortable with Zoom recording and a follow-up take-home if needed. Shes available between 1:15pm–3:30pm PT today.

Can the panel do a compressed session or do we want to offer the split option? If compressed, recommend prioritizing system-design + targeted coding exercise (we can shorten behavioral questions).

Bryce
TalentHunt

--
Note: Candidate contact is elena.martinez@gmail.com

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Martinez — daycare cancellation, asking for compressed slot today

Thanks Bryce —

Option A (preferred): Compress to a single 75-minute interview at 1:30pm PT focusing on system design (35m) + 30m focused coding (pairing on one micro-problem). We can skip the broader behavioral deep-dive and handle that during debrief or post-offer. We will record the session with candidate consent.

Option B (fallback): 20m live screen to check problem-solving and communication + send 90-minute take-home coding task to be completed within 48 hours.

Marissa — can you confirm candidate goes for Option A? If so I will lock calendar, send Zoom, and ask panel to be ready with the narrowed rubric. Laura / Steph — are you available 1:30–2:45pm PT? If not, earliest alternate is 2:15–3:30pm PT (same day).

Also, candidate mentioned needing childcare reimbursement if she arranges backup care today. We typically reimburse up to $50 for last-minute backup childcare for on-site interviews; confirm whether we extend for remote compressed interviews today. Marissa, can you collect any receipts and handle routing to finance?

-Rafael
Staff Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Martinez — childcare overlap, compressed slot ok

Thanks Rafael — Im good for 1:30–2:45pm PT. Steph, if you can take the coding portion (pairing) Ill cover the system-design portion. Please keep the design focused on one end-to-end component (well pick the notes I saved in the brief).

Re: reimbursement: approve up to $60 for last-minute childcare expenses for remote interviews today. Marissa, please confirm with candidate and collect receipt; well route through recruiting expense.

One more ask: capture a short behavioral note set in the debrief doc (hiring.jl/notes/ELENA) so we dont lose that signal if we shorten live time. Rafael, can you create the doc and share?

-Laura
Hiring Manager, Compute Team
Redwood Inference

Thank you for the quick responses and for being flexible. Im comfortable with Option A (75-minute consolidated interview). I can do 1:30–2:45pm PT and I consent to recording the Zoom for internal review only.

Im also able to arrange backup childcare but will need the reimbursement — Ill send a photo of the cancellation notice and the receipt after I pay. Attached is my resume and a screenshot of the daycare cancellation text for now.

Looking forward to the interview.
